fato_historico: 1989: A massacre is carried out by an Indian Peace Keeping Force in Sri Lanka killing 64 ethnic Tamil civilians.
energia_do_dia: Today, your spirit may feel called to cultivate deep inner peace, perhaps reflecting on the value of harmony in a world that often struggles with discord. Consider how you can be a beacon of gentle stability for others, nurturing kindness even when history reminds us of humanity's past challenges. It is a good time to ground yourself.
frase_do_dia: Kindness is the soil where true and lasting serenity grows for everyone.
significado_numero: Represents the infinite flow of balance and enduring prosperity in life.
conselho: Practice patience and offer a helping hand to those walking beside you today.
